newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Bids show little change.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Bids show little change.

text.p: Dark northern spring wheat bids showed little change Tuesday following sharp losses on Monday, and some dealers reported active sales.
"We were buying some grain today," a Montana dealer said. "A lot of farmers were waiting to see if we got rain before they sold, and we got rain."
Much-needed rain fell in eastern Montana and parts of North Dakota and helped alleviate dry conditions in those spring wheat states, dealers said.
Futures on the Minneapolis Grain Exchange provided little direction to cash dealers.
MGE July wheat settled up 1-1/4 cent higher at $3.84-3/4, while other months were 1/2 lower to 3/4 higher.
